title: CANcestry hardware WCCA / derating row (v0.1.0)
description: Row contract for hw/wcca/wcca-analysis.csv (issue #56, H-09; HW-NF-002, HW-NF-003; HwAGENTS.md rules 1, 2, 15). One row per (component, stress) pair: the rated maximum, the worst-case operating value derived in docs/hw/wcca-derating.md, the derating ratio worst_case/rated_max, the HW-NF-003 threshold that applies to the stress/category pair (0.80 for capacitor voltage/current and for every temperature row per HW-NF-002; 0.70 for voltage/current of every other category) and the verdict. A FAIL row must name a waiver_id registered on its own line in the waiver register of docs/hw/wcca-derating.md; ci/check_hw_wcca.py recomputes the ratio, the threshold and the verdict and fails closed on any drift, on an unregistered waiver or on a malformed row. Every number cites a schema-validated extract under hw/bom/datasheets/ (source_extract + source_entry).

part_id.description: BOM part (PRT-nnn of hw/bom/bom.json) or a named net/conductor (NET-xxx) for conductor rows.

category.description: BOM category (hw-bom-0.1.0) plus 'conductor' for PCB traces; selects the HW-NF-003 threshold together with the stress.

rated_basis.description: What the rating is: a datasheet absolute maximum, a recommended-operating maximum, a minimum rating the part selection must meet (selection-constraint; the WCCA sets it), or a computed conductor ampacity.

condition.description: Worst-case operating condition under which worst_case applies (rail tolerance, ambient, load).

derating_ratio.description: worst_case / rated_max rounded to 6 decimals; recomputed by ci/check_hw_wcca.py.

verdict.description: PASS iff derating_ratio <= threshold. FAIL rows require a registered waiver_id; the waiver never turns the verdict into PASS.

waiver_id.description: '-' for PASS rows; WCCA-W-nnn registered in the waiver register of docs/hw/wcca-derating.md for FAIL rows.

source_extract.description: Schema-validated extract(s) under hw/bom/datasheets/ carrying rated_max and the worst-case inputs; ';'-separated when several.

source_entry.description: Entry name(s) in source_extract carrying rated_max and the worst-case inputs.
